blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Open sort menu traps Tab and cannot be closed with Escape) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Keyboard users are trapped in the open menu (WCAG 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 2.1.1 Keyboard). With the menu open, Tab and Shift+Tab are both cancelled and move focus to the next item, wrapping round the four options, so focus never reaches the product list or the rest of the page; no Escape handler exists either, so the only way out is to pick an option, which changes the sort. Following the APG menu button pattern, let Tab close the menu without preventing the default move, and handle Escape to close the menu and return focus to the "Sort" button (button.current?.focus()). A native <select> labelled "Sort products" would give all of this for free.
findings.title: Open sort menu traps Tab and cannot be closed with Escape

findings.evidence: <button ref={button} type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
findings.recommendation: Screen reader users are told the wrong state (WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value): after activating "Sort: Newest" the menu opens, but the button still reports "collapsed", because aria-expanded is the constant "false". Bind it to the state: aria-expanded={open}.
findings.title: Menu button always announces aria-expanded="false"
